chunks: They said: 'Either you cast (your spell), O Moses, or we shall cast it first.'
ai.seo_question: What did Pharaoh's magicians say to Moses before the contest of miracles?
ai.summary: In this verse, Pharaoh's magicians issue a challenge to Prophet Moses (AS), demanding he initiate the display of miracles to establish precedence in the contest between divine truth and royal power. This moment underscores the psychological tension of the duel, where the magicians seek to assert their authority before Moses reveals the superiority of his staff turning into a serpent. The exchange highlights the competitive nature of the spectacle, setting the stage for the subsequent miraculous demonstration.
